_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading content and analytics provider serving the capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', with McGraw-Hill Education held for sale and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: The McGraw-Hill Companies 'is a leading content and analytics provider serving the capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material impact on our results of operations', with McGraw-Hill Education held for sale and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.72x; +51% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.72; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (Q3 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +21.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2013-11-22) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.72x (74.4% downside to Bear $19 / +15.8% upside to Bull $86) | Adj composite 2.66 vs market 3.38: gap -0.72 [OVERVALUED] | +51% above the EPP floor $49 (15x FY13E $3.27) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1.5% total (+0.8%/yr) | At 22.7x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $98 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +7.1% in Q3 2013, forward revenues +7% (no FY13 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2013 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
